title: first_time_renter_values appends never_rented_before without filtering — same key-find shadowing trap the sibling helper documents
detail: renter_values_with_status filters employment_status before appending to avoid first-match shadowing, with an explicit comment. first_time_renter_values appends never_rented_before without filtering it. If the base fixture contains never_rented_before (likely, as an employed renter), the appended "on" is shadowed and three tests silently exercise a non-first-time-renter.
recommended_fix: Add `&& pair.0 != "never_rented_before"` to first_time_renter_values' filter before appending the override, matching renter_values_with_status's documented pattern.

title: student_helper retains family-presuming guarantor framing while the same diff rewrites guarantor_intro to ban it
evidence:
pub const student_helper: String = "Most landlords accept parental support or a grant. Add any parental support under Additional Income Sources below. A parent can also step in as your Character Reference, or act as a guarantor in the section below."

-pub const guarantor_intro: String = "A guarantor \u{2014} usually a parent \u{2014} can strengthen your application,...
+pub const guarantor_intro: String = "A guarantor \u{2014} a parent, relative, friend, or Employer; anyone 18+..."
detail: The spec's copy doctrine bans family-presuming guarantor framing and mandates definition-based copy; guarantor_intro was rewritten accordingly. student_helper (shown to the student cohort) still says "A parent can also... act as a guarantor", undermining the doctrine on the exact cohort the policy targets.
recommended_fix: Rewrite student_helper's guarantor clause to the definition-based framing used in guarantor_intro ("someone 18+ with a steady, verifiable income"), or drop the guarantor mention entirely since the new ahead-note already declares it.

title: guarantor_intro capitalizes "Employer" mid-sentence, breaking the parallel list
evidence: pub const guarantor_intro: String = "A guarantor \u{2014} a parent, relative, friend, or Employer; anyone 18+ with a steady, verifiable income who agrees to back you \u{2014} can strengthen your application.
detail: In the list "a parent, relative, friend, or Employer" the capital E is inconsistent with the lowercase parallel items and is mid-sentence; this is user-facing copy rendered on the form.
recommended_fix: Lowercase to "or employer" to match the parallel structure of the surrounding list.
